description: Ensures agent performs thorough pre-merge code review

criteria.description: Skill prompt requires reviewing the actual diff/changes, not just file contents
Skill prompt includes checking for security vulnerabilities (XSS, injection, auth bypass)
Skill prompt includes checking for performance issues (N+1 queries, unnecessary re-renders)
Skill prompt requires verifying test coverage for changed code
Skill prompt requires checking for breaking API or interface changes
Skill prompt checks that new code follows project conventions
